text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — trying to shrink the operator path for automatic rollouts + fallback. current UX feels noisy when a degrade mode flips.
Jasper Ortiz: Agreed. Ops get 4 banners and a modal right now. too many interrupts. :grimacing:
Ava Patel: Can we collapse to a single compact 'safeguard' chip with hover details and a timeline expand? keeps visibility but reduces modal churn.
Lee Novak: Love the chip idea. we still need a clear CTA for immediate rollback/ack. ops often want 1-click confirm.
Maya Chen: CTA should be there but not primary. primary action = "View audit & metrics". CTA secondary = "Override (operator)".
Riley Gomez: What about error triggers? we have many: 5xx spike, latency P95, quality regressions (eval fail). do we show which one fired in the chip?
Jasper Ortiz: Show a short badge: `5xx` or `latency` + a short tooltip with the raw metric. avoid long text in the compact state.
Ava Patel: Also include small red/yellow/green dot for severity. color legend in the timeline panel.
deploy-bot: [notice] Canary rollout 2023-11-14T09:12:11Z: fallback initiated due to p95_latency>1200ms.
Lee Novak: For the audit flow, ops wants a stamped timeline entry and a prefilled incident note when they click 'Acknowledge'. we should capture: trigger, model version, route, sampling id.
Maya Chen: Agree. minimal fields on ack: who, why (preset list + free text), and whether to auto-restore when metric recovers.
Riley Gomez: UX question: when auto-restore is enabled, do we show a countdown or just a passive 'watching' state?
Jasper Ortiz: Countdown is anxiety-inducing. show 'watching — will auto-restore on sustained healthy metrics' + last sample time. expand for more.
Ava Patel: Implementation note — the backend will emit an event `safeguard.triggered` with payload. UI should render generic fields from payload to keep coupling low. sample payload snippet: ```
{
  "trigger": "p95_latency",
  "value": 1350,
  "threshold": 1200,
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "model": "redwood-rlf-3b",
  "sampling_id": "smp_0a1b2c"
}
```
Lee Novak: Perfect. include a 'copy payload' button too for paste into runbooks.
Maya Chen: Audit retention — legal asked for 1 year by default for enterprise. make retention editable per workspace.
Riley Gomez: Telemetry: one-click drilldown to the last N requests that matched the trigger, with anonymized tokens. ops needs to replay the samples in the sandbox.
Jasper Ortiz: Can we add a small 'simulate rollback' toggle in the timeline when viewing a trigger? Runs the rollback logic in dry-run and shows expected traffic split. :thinking_face:
Ava Patel: YES — dry-run is huge. show expected latency/cost delta in the preview.
deploy-bot: [action] Created issue: ENG-rlf-842 "safeguard compact chip + audit timeline"
Lee Novak: Next steps: Maya to mock compact chip + expanded timeline, Jasper to spec payload fields and UI contract, Ava to wire the dry-run preview data points.
Maya Chen: I'll drop a Figma by EOD and ping this thread. tagging @Riley Gomez for telemetry acceptance criteria.
Riley Gomez: I'll take acceptance for telemetry. quick checklist: event shape, sample export, replay link, anonymization rules.
Ava Patel: One more edge: if multiple triggers fire within 30s, collapse into a single timeline group with 'multi-trigger' tag and list triggers on expand. avoids alert storm.
Jasper Ortiz: Sounds good. keep the chip summary: severity badge, primary trigger short name, model, quick actions (view/audit/override).
Maya Chen: Cool. thanks all — will post mock and prototype link here when ready. 
Lee Novak: :thumbsup:
Riley Gomez: :rocket:
